arguments.text: 6 km, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Pacer runs effort off pod reserve. My jobs: (1) check pod gain vs boat/GPS/heart rate each leg (compare same-direction legs; current flips sign by direction); correct pod_gain only on clear evidence; (2) watch for drag/weed (local push drop) and clear rudder if pacer misses it; (3) radio messages: course/distance changes -> set_race_distance and tell paddler; (4) answer paddler talk. Keep cues few.

arguments.name: pod_to_boat
arguments.description: pod shaft power over boat-model power; pre-race test ratio 166/112 = 1.48. Rises with pod reading high or extra drag; falls with pod reading low.

arguments.message: pod/boat power ratio high: pod drifting up, or drag/weed
pod/boat power ratio low: pod reading low, or strong unmodelled push

arguments.text: t=61s start: shaft 208 W, boat 149 W, ratio 1.40 (test 1.48), HR 159, rate 73, push_local +0.19 though push_along -0.05 (not yet fitted, no turn). Start is hard, expect settle.

arguments.reason: first turn done: compare leg 1 and early leg 2

text: no cue: start phase, set up pod/boat ratio watches and a wake after the first turn.

arguments.text: t=240s: shaft 186 W (CP 166), boat 132 W (CP 112), ratio 1.41; pod reserve 58%, boat reserve 35%; HR 181 still climbing. Pacer eased at 110 s. Boat reserve draining faster than pod one; watch if pod reads low (HR keeps rising at pod ~CP).

text: no cue: still settling after the start; waiting for the first turn to compare directions.
no cue: still settling after the start; waiting for the first turn to compare directions.

arguments.text: Leg 1 (out, 100-285 s): pod 188 W, boat 136 W, GPS 3.22, rate 67, HR 178 rising 3.1 bpm/min (above CP, consistent). Computer share 0.683, push ~+0.03 out. Leg 2 back starts 327 s. Plan: measure leg1 vs leg2 for share/push at end of leg 2.

arguments.reason: end of leg 2: measure leg 1 vs leg 2 for share and push

text: no cue: nothing abnormal yet; measuring both directions at end of leg 2.

arguments.name: critical_power_pod_w
arguments.evidence: Test 166 W. Held 187-188 W for 7 min with only -1% fade; HR 183 rising 0.8 bpm/min (slowing from 3/min); paddler says 8/10 hard but holding. Boat-model reserve already 0 but no collapse.

arguments.name: share_pod_to_boat
arguments.evidence: hull fit leg1 out (100-285 s) vs leg2 back (345-505 s); push along out -0.016 m/s (current/wind tiny). Test ratio 112/166=0.675; computer running 0.689.

arguments.message: pod reserve near empty: check whether speed and power hold (CP higher than test?) or collapse

arguments.text: t=507s: pod 187 W steady both legs, share fit 0.718 (computer 0.689), push ~0. Pod reserve 26%, empties ~600 m; boat reserve 0 yet no fade (-1%). HR 184 rising ~0.8/min. Paddler 8/10 hard but holding. Pacer eased once at 110 s only. Key test: when pod reserve hits 0 (~t=690), does speed hold? If yes, CP above test.

text: no cue: paddler holding 187 W steadily; watching whether the pod reserve reaching zero brings a fade.

arguments.text: t=581s: paddler says boat heavy, rudder? Speed through water -5% at same pod 187 W, boat power 115, push_local -0.06. Pacer cued clear_rudder at 581. Check ~60-90 s later whether speed recovered (weed cleared) or not (something else: drag not on rudder, e.g. hull/ama; then a second clear may not help).

arguments.reason: check whether pacer clear_rudder at 581 s restored speed

text: no cue: pacer already called clear_rudder for the heavy boat; checking the result in 75 s.
no cue: drop began ~552 s (push_local to -0.08); big dip at ~590 s looks like the pacer back-stroke; recheck at 659 s.

arguments.question: Did the back-stroke clear it? Does the boat still feel heavy?

arguments.text: Still dragging. One more back-stroke to clear the rudder.

t=661s: after pacer clear at 581 and turn ~610, out-leg speed 3.03 at pod 186 vs 3.24 expected (share 0.718): ~-0.2 m/s, still slow and declining 627-660. I cued clear_rudder at ~661. If speed does not recover within ~60 s after, drag is not rudder weed (or re-catching weed); stop clearing then.

arguments.reason: check my clear_rudder at 661 s: did speed recover?

text: Cued clear_rudder: boat still 0.2 m/s slow at the same pod power after the pacer clear and the turn; checking the result in 80 s.
no cue: pod reserve reaching zero as expected; waiting to see if power and speed hold and whether my rudder clear worked (check at 760 s).

arguments.text: Boat still slow. Sharp back-stroke now, knock the rudder clean.

arguments.message: pod power fell below 172 W: paddler forced down (reserve really empty?) or pacer eased

arguments.text: t=761s: my clear at 680 not executed (no back-stroke seen). Speed steady 3.10 at pod 184 (out) since 670 vs ~3.20 expected from leg 1: steady -0.10 m/s, not growing. Cued clear again at ~761. Pod reserve (test CP 166) hit 0 at ~750 s but paddler holds 184 W, HR 189 rising ~1/min: CP likely above test. If holds 3+ more min, consider pod_gain or watch the finish (pacer finish push needs pod reserve >40%).

arguments.reason: did 2nd clear fix speed; is paddler still holding 184 W with pod reserve 0 (CP above test)?

text: Cued clear_rudder again: steady 0.1 m/s speed deficit and my previous clear was not carried out; checking in 2 min.

arguments.text: t=788s RADIO: wind filling in from the south 8-12 kn = tailwind on out legs (heading 0, legs 1/3/5), headwind on back legs (2/4/6). push_along lags; push_local will rise out, fall back. Pacer clear_rudder rule may false-fire on back leg as wind builds. Compare pod-vs-speed only as out+back averages from now. Big dip at ~775 = my 2nd back-stroke (cued 769).

text: no cue: noted the wind report; waiting on the result of the back-stroke.
no cue: wind report noted (tailwind out, headwind back); waiting on the back-stroke result.

arguments.text: t=797s: paddler says legs going, close to limit. Pod reserve 0 (test CP 166), pod 183 W, HR 189 now flat (ceiling?). 2nd back-stroke WAS done (35% dip at ~775) but speed still ~3.05-3.10 out (expected ~3.20 + tailwind): deficit NOT rudder weed -> likely tired blade/fatigue (or pod reading high). Stop clearing rudder. Expect pacer rate_down (fade -5..-8%) or a forced drop; watch pod_power_drop.

arguments.name: speed_deficit_cause
arguments.evidence: deficit ~0.1-0.15 m/s since 552 s; persisted after pacer clear (581) and executed back-stroke (~775); paddler at test-reserve 0 says legs going; HR flat 189.

text: no cue: paddler near limit with pod reserve empty; effort is the pacer job; back-strokes did not restore speed so no more clearing.
no cue: paddler near limit with pod reserve empty; effort is the pacer job; back-strokes did not restore speed so no more clearing.

arguments.text: Tailwind now, headwind after the turn. Hold your effort, ignore pace.

t=890s: tailwind arrived on leg 3 (out): GPS 3.36 at pod 182 (was 3.06), push_local +0.19, push_along still -0.02 (lagging) so speed_water/boat power read too high now and will read too LOW on back legs -> pacer rate_down may false-fire into the headwind. Paddler held 182-183 W 130 s past test-reserve 0, HR 190 creeping ~1/min: true CP a bit above test or W bigger, but probably still slightly above CP. Told paddler about wind at 890.

arguments.reason: into the headwind on leg 4: check push fit catches up, pacer rate_down false-fire, paddler holding

text: Told the paddler the wind is behind now and ahead after the turn: hold effort, not pace.
no cue: low pod/boat ratio is the new tailwind with a lagging push fit, not the pod; removed the ratio watches.

arguments.text: t=966s: paddler forced down: pod fell steadily 184 (882 s) -> 153 W (969 s), HR flat 190 since ~840 s = ceiling (~191). True reserve ran out ~890 s vs test-model 750 s: test CP/W close, true capacity ~10-15% more W (or CP ~170). Below CP now, pod reserve should refill; pacer finish push needs >40% at 800 m to go. Watch for repeat blow-up cycles.

arguments.name: critical_power_pod_w
arguments.evidence: Held ~185 W until ~890 s then forced down to 153 W with HR at ceiling 190; test-model reserve emptied at ~750 s, so true capacity only modestly above test (CP ~166-172 or W ~18-19 kJ).

text: no cue: paddler forced below critical power after the reserve ran out; nothing on my levers helps the effort, letting it refill.

arguments.text: t=1045s: paddler blew up: pod 111 W, HR falling 180, pod reserve refilling (22%; 18-49% across CP 164-175). GPS 2.68 into headwind. Unresolved: speed deficit since 552 s is either drag not on rudder, tired blade, or pod reading ~5% high (would also fit blow-up at 890 s vs model 750 s). Cannot separate with GPS; HR at ceiling until now. Do NOT set pod_gain without independent evidence. Plan: check recovery after turn to leg 5; finish check at ~900 m to go (pacer finish needs pod reserve >40%).

arguments.reason: start of leg 5: measure legs 3-4 share/push with the wind, check paddler recovery and pod reserve trend
finish planning: pod reserve vs 40% finish rule, wind on last leg

text: no cue: paddler recovering below critical power after the blow-up; effort is the pacer job, waking at leg 5 and before the finish.

arguments.text: t=1225s SUSPECT POD READING LOW: leg 4 back pod 129 W but HR 188 rising 6.9 bpm/min (pod says reserve refilling 53%, HR says draining). GPS 2.82 into headwind at pod 129 implies headwind only -0.04 at gain 1, vs tailwind +0.16 (or +0.26 if drag persisted) on leg 3 -> implausible. Gain estimates: 0.88-0.91 (no drag) or ~0.73 (drag -0.1 persists; fits HR both in 1040-1135 falling and 1165-1225 rising). TEST: leg 5 tailwind after turn: gain 1 predicts GPS ~3.0 at pod 129; gain 0.73 + drag predicts ~3.3.

arguments.reason: leg 5 tailwind test of pod gain: GPS vs pod 40-60 s after the turn; then set pod_gain

text: no cue: evidence that the pod now reads low (HR climbing, paddler 10/10 at a pod 129 W, headwind loss too small); testing it on the tailwind leg before correcting the pod gain.
no cue: paddler near limit fits my suspicion the pod reads low; testing on the tailwind leg in about 90 s before correcting the pod gain.

arguments.name: pod_gain
arguments.evidence: Leg 5 tailwind test: GPS 3.29 at pod 127.5 W; leg 3 tailwind 860-930 gave 3.36 at pod 181 (gain 1 then). Same push -> true effort ~170 W, gain ~0.75. Leg 4 headwind consistent only with gain ~0.73 plus the persistent -0.1 m/s drag. HR 188-191 rising at pod 129 while pod reserve claimed refill; paddler 10/10 near limit. Pod reading fell 184->110 W over 890-1030 s while HR stayed at ceiling until ~990.

arguments.name: speed_deficit_cause
arguments.value: drag ~0.1 m/s since 552 s not cleared by back-strokes (hull/ama?) or tired blade
arguments.evidence: leg 3 pre-wind deficit -0.1 at gain 1; leg 4/5 wind symmetry only fits with it persisting

arguments.text: t=1357s: SET pod_gain 0.75 from 890 s ramp 140 s (pod reads low). Leg 5 test: GPS 3.29 at pod 127.5 (gain 1 would give ~3.0). True effort now ~170 W, HR at ceiling 190-191, true reserve near empty. Expect pacer pod reserve to drop to near 0 after recompute -> no fake finish push, no fake reassure. Watch for a step in push_local triggering a false pacer clear_rudder.

6 km, legs of 1000 m; out legs (north) tailwind, back legs headwind since ~850 s. Pod drift found: pod_gain set 0.75 from 890 s (ramp 140 s) - recheck on leg 6 headwind vs leg 4 (same direction): GPS at corrected pod should match. Persistent ~0.1 m/s drag since 552 s not fixed by back-strokes: do not clear again unless a new sudden drop. Paddler at true ~170 W, HR at ceiling, reserve near empty: no finish push expected. Answer paddler talk; keep cues few.

text: Corrected the boat computer: pod reads about 25% low since ~890 s (tailwind test confirmed), so the pacer no longer sees a fake refilled reserve. No cue.

arguments.text: t=1392s: after correction pod reads 172 W (raw 129), pod reserve 5.5%, empties ~500 m; boat-speed reserve says 49% but it counts the wind misfit and the 0.1 m/s drag as paddler, so ignore it. HR 190-191 ceiling. CP uncertainty (164-175) is as big as any effort tweak, so no piece; effort left to pacer.

text: no cue: correction applied; paddler near the edge of the reserve, and the critical power uncertainty is too large to justify an effort test.
no cue: pod correction in place; effort left to the pacer; next check before the finish.
